description.p: Ready2Rip is a secure CD ripper for Linux. Built as a modern GNOME app, it focuses on careful archival extraction with full cdparanoia (test & copy, retries, and drive calibration), then verifies results with AccurateRip.

It also looks up metadata via MusicBrainz (and FreeDB-compatible services), writes ReplayGain, and fetches album art with optional embed sizes—so you get trustworthy rips and complete tags in one place.
0.4.43: Use Pango.WrapMode for Gtk.Label wrap in the drive setup dialog so AppImage GTK 4.14 does not TypeError on first-run smoke.
0.4.42: Tolerate libadwaita 1.5 in the AppImage GNOME prefix when settings ViewStack transitions (1.7+) are unavailable, so Ubuntu 22.04 smoke tests and AppImageHub catalog checks pass.
0.4.41: Ship GLib/Gio typelibs from the AppImage GNOME prefix (so Gio.ApplicationFlags.DEFAULT_FLAGS works) and smoke-test AppImages under Xvfb on Ubuntu 22.04 before publish.

0.4.40: Build AppImages on Ubuntu 22.04 (glibc 2.35) with a modern GTK 4 / libadwaita prefix so they run on older LTS hosts and pass AppImageHub’s catalog tester; keeps 0.4.39 DirIcon and lossless-only .bin data-track behaviour.

0.4.37: Keep encode-format helpers free of PyGObject so CI unit tests import cleanly; same features as 0.4.36 (lossless-primary rip, Also encode lossy, LRCLIB lyrics, settings cleanup, lossless embed art, 100 MB art limit, metadata cache prune).
0.4.35: Sound Check from track ReplayGain; multi-artist tags kept separate across codecs; embed artwork for lossy only (≤800 px, default 600).
0.4.34: AIFF encode option; iTunes Sound Check (iTunNORM) for MP3 / M4A / AIFF / WAV with a Tags preference toggle.
0.4.32: Codec quality lists lowest→highest; Also encode lossy labels; rip log with the primary encode; CUE sheets for lossless only; keep the custom lossy output folder across layout changes.
0.4.31: Restore the green rip banner; advance progress once per finished track so the fill no longer stalls mid-extract.
0.4.30: Replace the custom CSS rip banner with a standard Gtk.ProgressBar.
0.4.29: Whole-rip progress (selected tracks or full disc), and fix extract progress stalling on partial cdparanoia stderr lines.
0.4.28: Progress bar no longer freezes during CRC/encode/verify; Also encode can write to a custom output folder.
0.4.27: Optional Also encode (lossy companion), Copy Image progress/overread trim fixes, and per-track edge overread.
0.4.26: Keep AAC encode argv helpers free of PyGObject (fix CI).
0.4.25: Keep secure-WAV unit tests free of PyGObject (fix CI).
0.4.24: Same as 0.4.23; fix Ruff import/branch lint that failed CI.
0.4.23: Drive overread when available, tighter WAV and CTDB quality gates, native AAC VBR, FLAC default level 5.

0.4.22: Remove barcode and ISRC edit fields from the UI and restore the previous Title / Artist track-row sizing. Tags and CUE sheets still receive barcode and ISRC when metadata or the disc provides them.

Gold-standard archival polish — AccurateRip and CTDB on Copy Image, hard sample-offset gate when verification is on (auto-resume after Detect), live CD-TEXT / MCN / ISRC from the disc, date / barcode / ISRC in tags, multi-disc CD1/ folders with matching CUE sheets, FreeDB disc N/M heuristics, FLAC level 8 with verify, and README catch-up.

More reliable rip progress (line-buffered extract updates, monotonic WAV-size progress, correct phase order), plain status labels without percents, and remove the empty-state eject button (header eject remains).
Live progress during cdparanoia extract (banner no longer stalls), and a trimmed tag set — title, album, artist, album artist, track/disc totals, genre, label, compilation, and ReplayGain only.
Remove the empty-state disc icon for all tray/no-disc screens (same as tray-open), grey out track select checkboxes while ripping, and trim unused helpers across CTDB, MMC, and disc modules.

Stronger secure-rip pipeline — warn when the drive sample offset is uncalibrated, one PCM pass for log peak plus AccurateRip/CTDB, safer encode-overlap cancel (no half files), louder burst honesty with EAC log checksums, CTDB submit quality 100 only for clean secure test&copy, and honest CD-TEXT/MCN/ISRC stubs. Default embed art size 1000px; clear the empty-state disc icon when the tray is open.

Picard-aligned tags for FLAC/Opus, MP3, and M4A — multi-value artists, split track/disc totals, correct MusicBrainz recording IDs, and richer barcode/catalog/country fields. Artist style setting applies to filenames; feat. still rewrites titles.
Write multi-artist separators into tags (semicolon, slash, or feat. on the title), show a bottom toast while looking up metadata, and keep path-migration unit tests free of PyGObject.

Multi-artist save styles (semicolon, slash, feat.), multi-disc-safe default filenames ({disc_track}), leaner naming presets with hover hints, and Custom templates that stay empty until Custom is chosen. Encoder list order WAV→FLAC→Opus→M4A→MP3; AppImage GIRepository 3.0 and ./run host-Python fixes.

Rework sample-offset detection popup, grow cover art to match the Album block, defer metadata until setup finishes, and remove the top lookup progress bar. Snappier disc and tray updates; ready2rip branding in UI copy.

Artwork hover actions, naming scheme presets, nested sample-offset settings, and UI capitalization cleanup. Remove dual-encode option. Album fields grey out while ripping; track Title/Artist spacing restored.
Track list layout polish.
Bundle CA certificates in the AppImage so HTTPS metadata and artwork lookups work with the bundled OpenSSL.
Facing UI layout (art 1/3 + album 2/3, flat editors, header actions); MusicBrainz top genre; remove in-app CD playback; sharper HiDPI cover art.
Ripping disc progress banner with green success and red cancel/error flash; AppImage rebuilt for broader Linux compatibility.
CTDB confirm and new-parity submit (Galois16 encode, syndrome upload); optional Submit to CTDB; hasparity repair probe (no PCM rewrite yet).
Security hardening (device allowlist, fetch host allowlist, cache path checks); data-track test & copy; stronger cache defeat for full-disc images; correct whole-album ReplayGain.
Full INDEX 00 pregaps in CUE sheets (EAC default / noncompliant) and mixed-mode / CD-Extra data tracks as raw 2352-byte .bin files. Secure extract flags unchanged.
Clean up dead code and shared helpers (unused rip states, pref-row tracking, PCM CRC and duration formatting) without changing rip behaviour.

Fix truncated rips after in-app playback (wait for GStreamer to release the drive); avoid duplicate GNOME icons with AppImage/Gear Lever; bundle CDDA plugins for AppImage playback; remove unused code.
Theme consistency fixes; updated app icons (PNG + SVG); dark-mode polish; README screenshot refresh.

Secure-CD-ripper-for-Linux positioning; System/Light/Dark appearance with pure-black dark and warm-grey light chrome; Art + Album side-by-side layout with cover origin/size captions; nested embed under Download artwork; Calibrate drive in Ripping; UI refactor (window.ui, theme module).
Secure cdparanoia extraction with test & copy, AccurateRip, CUE/log output, Copy Image mode, AppImage packaging with Gear Lever update support, and UI polish.
